title: 第十格
subject: a couple in a Friday-night bowling league in Kowloon Bay where she bowls and he keeps the score sheet and shouts every strike
caption: Cantonese new jack swing in the late-80s dance R&B style. A swing-quantized sixteenth-note drum machine with a hard cracking gated snare and a swung hi-hat, synth-brass and orchestra-hit stabs on the off-beats, a rubbery synth bassline, a short bell-like FM synth hook in the intro that returns before the last chorus, a stripped drum-machine breakdown. Punchy and dry, snare and stabs forward, the bass round and centred. Agile male lead with clipped rhythmic phrasing, sung choruses, short shouted ad-libs placed for a dance routine. 106 BPM, D minor. Proud, playful and in love. No slow-jam ballad, no neo-soul Rhodes, no live horn section, no straight unswung beat, no trap hi-hats, no autotune, no rap chorus, no acoustic guitar.
lyrics:
[Verse]
禮拜五 九龍灣 保齡球館 第七條線
佢綁起頭髮 揀返嗰個十二磅粉紅色波
我坐喺後面 一支筆 一張計分紙
打咗三年聯賽 我一次都未落過場

[Pre-Chorus]
佢行四步 手一放
成個館 靜咗一秒

[Chorus]
Strike！ 我第一個企起身嗌
計分紙上面 又畫多個交叉
隔籬隊問我 「你又唔打 嚟做乜」
我話我份工 係同佢拍手

[Verse]
對面隊阿Sir 話我老婆手勢好重
我話屋企啲樽蓋 全部都係佢開
第九格 佢一波落坑 轉頭望住我
我照樣喺格仔度 畫個大大嘅笑臉


[Chorus]
Strike！ 第十格 連中三個
計分紙上面 交叉 交叉 交叉
全隊衝埋嚟 佢第一個攬嘅係我
我份工 就係同佢拍手

[Outro]
二百四十七分
我寫大啲 貼喺雪櫃
